topic: World money check-up (IMF October 2026 outlook), in plain words

scenes.vo: Big money news for the whole world. Is it good or bad?
headline: MONEY NEWS
FOR THE WORLD

scenes.vo: A group that nearly every country joins just checked the world's money.
facts: WHO: A WORLD MONEY GROUP OF COUNTRIES
WHERE: A MEETING IN BANGKOK, THAILAND
WHAT: A CHECK-UP ON THE WORLD'S MONEY

scenes.vo: Their question: how much more money will the world earn this year?
scenes.sub: = HOW MUCH MORE THE WORLD EARNS

scenes.vo: Their answer: 3.1 percent. That is a little more than July's guess.
scenes.sub: THE NEW GUESS FOR THIS YEAR

scenes.vo: But the gains are lopsided. Only 32 countries make 95 percent of it.
What is helping? Companies are spending a lot of money on AI.
facts: COMPANIES SPEND A LOT ON AI
THE REPORT: IT PROPS UP GROWTH

scenes.vo: The warning: if AI spending drops, or debt grows, growth could slow.
facts: RISK 1: A SHARP DROP IN AI SPENDING
EITHER ONE COULD SLOW THE WORLD

scenes.vo: In general, a slower world can touch jobs, prices and loans.
scenes.sub: HOW THIS CAN REACH EVERYDAY LIFE
facts: THIS IS A GENERAL IDEA, NOT ADVICE
IT CAN ALSO AFFECT PRICES AND LOANS

scenes.vo: Follow for world news in simple words. What should we explain next?
headline: WORLD NEWS
MADE SIMPLE
recap: BUT ONLY FEW COUNTRIES DRIVE IT
AI SPENDING AND DEBT ARE THE RISKS
